amendments.what: six discovered defects closed in one amendment commit, all found by wave-1 seats before any control score and before any deciding invocation (predicates, targets and denominators unchanged): (a) c2/measure.py arm6 read SOURCES' status column at index 8 (the opened date) so the knowledge-note docs cell could never score and C2_R56_PASS was unreachable - now cells[7] (T56W1CritC2 kill-shot); arm2/arm5 now copy .sha256 sidecars so the gate's digest binding is live; QUALITY cell requires RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT and the SKILL cell is scoped to ## Standing rules. (b) controls.sh emitted clone-local commit SHAs as `rev=` tokens the receipt gate cannot resolve - emit() relabels them `clone_rev=`; the committed receipts now carry .sha256 siblings (T56W1ExecControls finding, CritC2). (c) deciding-run.sh read control receipts from the worktree and gated them before the dirty-tree check, excluded untracked paths by unanchored prefix, accepted a non-empty OUTDIR, accepted any CONTROLS fraction and CTL_MISMATCH lines, could not run c1/measure.py (frozen input never materialized - RevFreeze H1), did not pin FREEZE to the last freeze.json commit (H2), and hardcoded its FROZEN list (now contract-derived); the freeze-integrity heredoc now checks manifest keys == contract surface, amendment record shape, and that contract.amendments mirrors freeze.json.amendments. (d) receipt-revision-gate.py declared RECEIPT_NOT_BLOB without emitting it (directory receipt crashed) and had no cases for its usage surface - now emits the code and the suite is 19 cases (not-blob, json-rev, unknown-role, zero-receipts, unresolvable-certified); drifted_paths reports paths unresolvable at both revisions. (e) control/frozen-surface.paths omitted the contract, the receipt producers, the deciding script, no-harm, the manifest and the red-before slice (T56W1CritC2 unlisted-path exploit); the surface now lists them (LOG.md and SCORECARD.md stay unbound by design: the row product is written after the bind and verified by the c1 restate arm - recorded as residual). (f) the red-before slice and its .sha256 were committed as frozen inputs but absent from contract.frozen_paths/freeze.json (RevFreeze H3) - now in both manifests.
